title: CTAB DNA Extraction Protocol for Fungi
author: Erin Carr
materials: Obtain liquid nitrogen placed in Dewar
Re-suspend pellet in 350 µL of 5M NaCl

steps.title: Prepare Fungal Cultures
steps.instruction: Grow fungi in the preferred media type until they reach the mid-exponential phase (3-7 days) or grow to their maximum on the plate.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Fungal Cells
steps.instruction: Collect fungal samples and wash to remove media.

substeps.instruction: For liquid cultures: Pipette 1 mL of fungus into a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 10,000x g for 1 minute, wash with 1 mL of ddH2O 3 times (centrifuging between washes), and remove all liquid to obtain a tight pellet.

For plate cultures: Place 800 µL of water in a 1.5 mL tube (record weight), scrape 0.03 g of fungus off the plate into the tube avoiding agar, centrifuge at 10,000x g for 1 minute, and remove all water.

steps.title: Freeze and Grind Fungal Pellets
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the fungal cells using liquid nitrogen and a mortar and pestle.

substeps.instruction: Flash freeze the processed fungi pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C until ready for extraction.
With tube lids closed, tap lids against the table to dislodge the frozen pellet.
Transfer the pellet to a mortar (cleaned with 70% ethanol between samples) and add sterile liquid nitrogen.
Grind the fungus into a powder, adding more liquid nitrogen as needed to prevent the sample from becoming too liquidy.
Scrape the ground fungus into a fresh 1.5 mL tube and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer based on the number of samples.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the required volume of CTAB Extraction buffer (700 µL per sample, though the text mentions multiplying by 750 µL) and aliquot into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 1% w/v PVP (0.01 g/mL) and 1% v/v 20 mg/mL Proteinase K (5 µL per 500 µL) to the buffer.

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using heat and mechanical bead beating.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat a water bath or heat block to 70°C.
Add ~300 µL of glass beads to bead beating tubes.
Dislodge frozen pellets by pipetting 700 µL of the complete CTAB Extraction buffer into each sample tube.
Transfer the sample into the bead beating tubes.
Incubate in 70°C water bath/heat block for 5 minutes, then bead beat for 5 minutes; repeat this cycle 2 more times (30 minutes total).
Change the heat block/water bath temperature to 37°C (or use a 37°C incubator) after this step.
Confirm lysis by placing 5 µL of sample on a microscope slide; if not lysed, bead beat for an additional 2-5 minutes.

steps.title: Initial DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the liquid from the bead beating tubes to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the glass beads.
Add 1x volume of 24:1 Chloroform:Isoamyl, invert to mix, and centrifuge at 10,000x g for 5 minutes.
Collect the upper layer and transfer it to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using CTAB Precipitation buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of CTAB Precipitation buffer and mix by inverting for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000x g for 15 minutes.
Remove the supernatant, ensuring the pellet remains in the tube.
Add 2 µL of 10 mg/mL RNase A to the tubes and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add one volume of 24:1 Chloroform:Isoamyl and mix thoroughly by inverting.
Centrifuge at 10,000x g for 5 minutes.
Remove the upper phase and transfer to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 6 volumes of ice-cold isopropanol and mix by inverting.
Place tubes in -20°C freezer for 15 minutes, or overnight/multiple days.
Centrifuge at 4°C at 13,000x g for 20 minutes.
Remove all liquid and air dry for 30 minutes to overnight until dry.

steps.title: DNA Wash and Final Recovery
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet and resuspend in elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 30-50 µL of UltraPure water or TE buffer.
Add 0.1 volumes of 3M Sodium Acetate and 3 volumes of ice-cold 100% Ethanol; mix by inverting.
Freeze samples at -80°C for 20 minutes or -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge at 4°C at max speed for 30 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold 70% Ethanol, ensuring the pellet floats freely.
Centrifuge at 4°C at max speed for 10 minutes.
Remove ethanol and dry tubes completely (running air overnight is recommended).
Pre-heat elution buffer (TE or water) to 65°C and resuspend the DNA in 30-50 µL of the warmed buffer.
